title: 3 PROSE
use_cases: Use when aligning an AI writing assistant with specific user stylistic preferences.
Implement when mimicking a user's writing style based on prior task demonstrations.
Configure when iterative refinement is needed to bridge the gap between LLM output and user style.
Use when retrieving and aggregating task-relevant demonstrations from interaction memory.
Implement when pruning inconsistent preference components through verification steps.
